name: self-healing-pipeline
description: Monitors pipeline runs and applies the self-improving-agent skill to automatically propose and implement fixes for failures.
author: librefang

steps.name: fetch_errors
steps.prompt_template: Fetch recent pipeline errors from the last hour.

steps.name: analyze_failures
steps.prompt_template: Analyze the stack traces and pipeline states to propose a fix.

steps.name: apply_fix
steps.prompt_template: Apply the proposed fix and restart the affected agents.

steps.name: alert_operator
steps.prompt_template: Notify the operator in the command-center that a self-healing action was taken.
